title: Decoupled Messaging
summary: A producer hands work to a routing layer so consumers can process it independently.
recognition_signals: producer and consumer lifetimes should be independent
work may need buffering during traffic bursts
multiple consumers may each need their own copy
core_rules: Independent consumers should not share one destructive-consumption path when each needs its own copy.
structural_steps: consumer-specific delivery path receives a copy

common_confusions.distinction: A queue distributes each message to one competing consumer. Pub/sub delivers its own copy to every subscriber.
